headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 7, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies secured a 9-5 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Brandon Marsh leading the offense. The New York Yankees dominated the Boston Red Sox, securing a 6-1 victory. The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 4-6 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, handing the Orioles their loss.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, with the Los Angeles Angels placing right-handed pitcher Jack Kochanowicz on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. The Milwaukee Brewers have placed right-handed pitcher Quinn Priester on the 60-day injured list due to right thoracic outlet syndrome. The New York Yankees have placed catcher Austin Wells on the 10-day injured list due to cervical headaches.

The Colorado Rockies have acquired shortstop Richie Martin Jr. in a trade with the Texas Rangers. The Los Angeles Angels have also made a trade, sending catcher Austin Wynns to the Atlanta Braves for cash.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall Short in Atlanta**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates dropped a 2-3 decision to the Atlanta Braves, unable to overcome a strong performance from the Braves' bullpen.

top_news.title: **Phillies Take Down White Sox 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a 9-5 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Brandon Marsh leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Jonathan Bowlan pitched 2 strong innings for the White Sox, striking out 3 batters and allowing no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Cruise Past Red Sox 6-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees dominated the Boston Red Sox, securing a 6-1 victory. Jazz Chisholm Jr. led the Red Sox offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Fall to Blue Jays in 4-6 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 4-6 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, handing the Orioles their loss. Taylor Ward led the Orioles' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Angels RHP Jack Kochanowicz Lands on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Angels right-handed pitcher Jack Kochanowicz has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation.

top_news.title: **Rockies Acquire Richie Martin Jr. in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies have made a move to bolster their roster, acquiring shortstop Richie Martin Jr. in a trade with the Texas Rangers.
